# sophosfirewall_web_policy (Data Source)

Looks up an existing web policy by name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "sophosfirewall_web_policy" "default" {
  name = "Default Workplace Policy"
}

output "default_workplace_rules" {
  value = length(data.sophosfirewall_web_policy.default.rules)
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Unique name of the web policy. Changing this forces a new resource.

### Read-Only

- `default_action` (String) Action for traffic that matches no rule. One of `allow`, `deny`.
- `description` (String) Free-text description.
- `enforce_safe_search` (Boolean) Enforce SafeSearch on search engines. Omit to keep the firewall's setting.
- `filter_by_image_license` (Boolean) Only show Creative Commons licensed images in image search results. Omit to keep the firewall's setting.
- `google_app_domains` (Set of String) Domains allowed to sign in to Google services, e.g. `example.com`. The firewall stores them comma separated in at most 256 characters.
- `id` (String) UUID of the object assigned by the firewall.
- `max_file_size` (Number) Largest allowed download in MB (1-1536) when `restrict_file_size` is `true`. Defaults to `300`.
- `office365_directory_id` (String) Microsoft 365 directory (tenant) ID sent with the tenant restriction.
- `office365_tenants` (Set of String) Tenant domains or directory IDs allowed to access Microsoft 365. The firewall stores them comma separated in at most 4,096 characters.
- `propagate_x_forwarded_for` (Boolean) Send the client's IP address to web servers in an `X-Forwarded-For` header. Omit to keep the firewall's setting.
- `quota_limit` (Number) Browsing time in minutes allowed per day for rules with the `quota` action (10-1440, a multiple of 10). Omit to keep the firewall's setting.
- `reporting` (Boolean) Include traffic matched by this policy in reports. Omit to keep the firewall's setting.
- `restrict_file_size` (Boolean) Block downloads larger than `max_file_size`. Omit to keep the firewall's setting.
- `restrict_google_app_domains` (Boolean) Only allow access to Google services for the domains in `google_app_domains`. Omit to keep the firewall's setting.
- `restrict_office365_tenants` (Boolean) Only allow access to Microsoft 365 for the tenants in `office365_tenants`. Omit to keep the firewall's setting.
- `rules` (Attributes List) Rules in evaluation order (at most 1,024). Omit to leave the rules unmanaged; a new policy is then created without rules. Removing the attribute later deletes all rules. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rules))
- `youtube_filter` (String) YouTube Restricted Mode: `off`, `moderate` (standard restricted mode) or `strict`. Omit to keep the firewall's setting. One of `off`, `moderate`, `strict`.

<a id="nestedatt--rules"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rules`

Read-Only:

- `apply_content_filters` (Boolean) Also match the `content_filters` (keyword lists). Requires `content_filters` and `follow_http_action`. Defaults to `false`.
- `categories` (Set of String) Web categories to match, e.g. `Gambling`.
- `content_filters` (Set of String) Content filters (keyword lists) to match when `apply_content_filters` is `true`.
- `dynamic_categories` (Set of String) Dynamic categories to match. Rules with dynamic categories cannot apply content filters.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the rule is active. Defaults to `true`.
- `file_types` (Set of String) File types to match, e.g. `Executable Files`.
- `follow_http_action` (Boolean) Apply `http_action` to HTTPS traffic too. Set to `false` to choose `https_action` separately. Defaults to `true`.
- `http_action` (String) Action for matching HTTP traffic. One of `allow`, `deny`, `warn`, `log`, `quota`. With `dynamic_categories` only `allow` and `deny` are accepted, with `apply_content_filters` only `deny` and `log`; otherwise `log` is not accepted.
- `https_action` (String) Action for matching HTTPS traffic. Required when `follow_http_action` is `false`, not allowed otherwise. One of `allow`, `deny`, `warn`, `log`, `quota`. With `dynamic_categories` only `allow` and `deny` are accepted, with `apply_content_filters` only `deny` and `log`; otherwise `log` is not accepted.
- `schedule` (String) Name of the schedule during which the rule applies. Defaults to `All The Time`.
- `url_groups` (Set of String) URL groups to match (`sophosfirewall_url_group`).
- `user_activities` (Set of String) User activities to match.
- `user_groups` (Set of String) User groups the rule applies to.
- `users` (Set of String) Users the rule applies to. Omit both `users` and `user_groups` to apply the rule to anybody.
